sections.title: Unit 26: Media Ownership and Regulation, 2010–2026
body: Between 2010 and 2026 Hungary changed its media laws, the ownership of many news outlets and the rules for state advertising. Some observers saw a rebalancing, others a concentration of media power; the courts of the European Union and several institutions took positions on parts of it.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: reported speech, concession, verbal nouns, participles and contrast. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
